name: Store Health Assistant
description: Daily WooCommerce store health digest with configurable alert thresholds.

readme.shortDescription: Get a daily WooCommerce store health report by email with configurable alert thresholds.
readme.longDescription:
Store Health Assistant runs a daily check of your WooCommerce store and emails you a concise health digest: total orders, revenue, low-stock products, failed payments and abandoned carts. Every threshold is configurable, so you only hear about it when something actually needs attention.

= Features =

* Daily (or custom-interval) store health digest delivered by email
* Configurable low-stock, revenue-drop and failed-payment thresholds
* Historical reports stored in a custom table - no post-table bloat
* CSV export of any report period
* REST endpoints for headless / external dashboards
* Fully translatable, WP-Cron based, HPOS-compatible

faqs.question: Does this plugin slow down my store?
faqs.answer: No. All heavy work runs on WP-Cron in the background and reads order data through indexed queries against the WooCommerce orders table.

faqs.question: Where are the reports stored?
faqs.answer: In a dedicated custom table ({prefix}_reports), created on activation. Nothing is written to wp_posts, so your main tables stay lean.

faqs.question: Can I send the digest to multiple recipients?
faqs.answer: Yes. The settings screen accepts a comma-separated list of recipient email addresses.
